fe.note: Grillage + DKT plate FE (plate v3): PP-C-20A 13.5 GPa, nu 0.35; the skin as DKT triangles, the ribs as T-beams (flange w + 12 t); held at the four screw bosses; 10 N on the lens ring, on the front skate or on the back skate, or the twist (three screws held, 10 N at the fourth).
